newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up six cents on smaller offering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up six cents on smaller offering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed up six cents at 14.91 ringgit ($5.95) a kg, helped by a smaller offering, traders said.
A $10 drop on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight did not dampen market sentiment, they said.
"The market was largely aided by the smaller offering," said one trader. Turnover was 48 tonnes against 75 on Wednesday.

Traders said that with offerings likely to be limited after the recent wave of selling, the price is seen climbing back to the 15 ringgit level. The local price premium over LME widened to $60 a tonne from $30 previously. --Syed Azman (603-2308911) ($1=2.5050 ringgit)
